messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error deploying app (error:00000000:lib(0):func(0):reason(0), errno 10053)
parts: good suggestions, thanks!
On Sun, Jul 20, 2014 at 10:27 PM, Jin Rou New <newj...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi Chad,

Was waiting for a response before trying to deploy the app again, but just tried and it seems to work successfully for now, so I'm guessing something was fixed? I'll update if I run into any more problems.

Related to this, two small suggestions:
- Output a warning for the user if the total app size is more than the limit of 100mb?
- Have some folders/files in the app folder be ignored for the upload (e.g. git folder), maybe using something like a gitignore file?

Thanks!

- JR


On Saturday, July 19, 2014 2:40:04 AM UTC+8, Chad Barraford wrote:
Hi Jin,
I wanted to check in with you and see if you've recently seen this issue. Thanks for letting me know.


On Sat, Jun 28, 2014 at 12:08 AM, Jin Rou New <newj...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Andy,

Just tried uploading my app (86mb total) and the upload fails about 5min in.

(One more suggestion: any possibility of having some folders/files in the app folder be ignored for the upload (e.g. git folder), maybe using something like a gitignore file?)

Thanks!

- Jin Rou


On Friday, June 27, 2014 10:17:16 PM UTC+8, Andy Kipp wrote:
You are correct the limit should be 100MB. I think I may know what is going on here. When the upload fails, about how long does it take for it to fail. (e.g. how long from when you start the upload until you get the error? 30 seconds? 1 minute? 5 minutes?)

-Andy


On Thu, Jun 26, 2014 at 10:46 PM, Jin Rou New <newj...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Joe,

I pared down my app folder size to 51mb and the issue seems to be resolved, so it seems to me like the error is because the ShinyApps server rejected my connection due to an overly-large app size? I had the impression that the max app size is 100mb though, yet when I add a 20mb file to my folder, I get the same error again.

Also, a suggestion: Output a warning for the user if the total app size is more than the limit of 100mb?

Thanks!

- Jin Rou

That error might be WSAECONNABORTED. Any chance you're running a network security suite, like Kaspersky, ESET, or Panda? If so, maybe try disabling it temporarily and see if that makes a difference?
